task: Implement the smallest safe, repeatable first V3 live-checkpoint deployment path on branch checkpoint/v3-first-live-deploy, starting from the branch's existing exact base main merge commit. This is the bounded post-#601 exit task: do not change apps/web product behaviour, Finder, Babylon, Inspect, scoring, schemas, migrations, production data, production routing, Redis/Valkey architecture, or add NATS as a V3 dependency. Contabo is non-production and also hosts exactly three self-hosted Codex runners. During this worker you MAY perform read-only host/repository inspection needed to prove topology/capacity/listeners/container names and find any existing checkpoint-capacity evidence, but MUST NOT start/stop/recreate/deploy services, write host config, read private keys/env-file contents, mutate databases, or change production. Implement repository code/workflows/runbook/tests only. The intended operating model is persistent checkpoint infrastructure: deployment updates may replace only the isolated V3 web/API application services; they must never tear down or recreate PostgreSQL, Redis/Valkey, NATS, edge/proxy services, runner services, or unrelated containers/volumes. Build and dependency resolution stay off-host. The deployed web/API images must come only from exact digest-pinned GHCR references authenticated by the immutable V3 release manifest/run provenance. Fix the first-deployment bootstrap paradox: bootstrap checkpoint #1 must not require an already-accepted prior V3 release. For bootstrap only, rollback is restoring the pre-deploy absence/state of the isolated checkpoint application/route by removing/reverting only the newly created allowlisted web/API checkpoint resources. For subsequent upgrades, require the prior accepted digest release plus a durable deployment receipt and support application-only rollback to it. Keep candidate/rollback release provenance, checksum and compatibility checks fail-closed. Derive an explicit isolated Compose/project/service namespace and resource limits from proven host facts; do not guess ports, paths, CPU/memory, networks, data source, or edge wiring. Prefer a previously authorized persistent non-production database/data source if one exists. If no authorized checkpoint DATABASE_URL/data source exists, do not use production DB and do not copy production data: make that configuration an explicit external secret/authority requirement and leave mutation stopped with an exact blocker. Redis/cache must remain optional for core Finder/Inspect correctness; do not make cache availability a bootstrap correctness requirement. NATS must not be introduced into the checkpoint baseline. The deploy workflow must use a strict service/resource allowlist, pull digest-pinned images, recreate only allowlisted V3 app services, perform origin smoke checks for /, /api/health, /openapi.json and /api/auth/session, verify reported build SHA/digests where available, and emit/store a sanitised deployment receipt with source SHA, image digests, target identity, changed resources, smoke outcomes and rollback identity. It must never run git pull/build/install on the target. Update the current deliberately-stopped v3-application-live-checkpoint-preflight path into a reviewed bootstrap-capable deploy boundary only to the extent host facts support it; preserve fail-closed behavior for any unproven fact. Add focused tests that prove bootstrap does not require a prior release, normal upgrade does, only the app allowlist can be mutated, infrastructure services/volumes cannot be recreated, digest-only images are required, and unsafe/missing target facts stop before mutation. Update current V3 operations documentation so Contabo remains explicitly non-production, checkpoint lifecycle is persistent rather than rebuild-every-run, and NATS is not a baseline dependency. Run all focused tests plus workflow/script contract tests affected by the change. Keep the diff narrow. Report exact host facts proven, exact remaining blockers (if any), exact files changed, tests run, and whether the resulting repository path is executable for the first checkpoint or still deliberately stopped. Do not widen scope to production promotion or general infrastructure cleanup.
